purpose: Measure whether the plan-review checker (option b) flags the defective replies and passes the clean ones, before wiring it into preparation. No production writes, no images.
authorization: Owner approved option (b) on 2026-10-23: a semantic check of each plan before storage with a bounded re-plan, plus relaxing the exact evidence-list rule. This measurement is charged to the existing evaluation allowance.

benchmark.replies: The 40 replies in ../2026-10-23-grounding-rate-check/blind-replies.json, reviewed in that blind order.
benchmark.truth: The agreed blind blocker flags (U, X, I, F) from ../2026-10-23-grounding-rate-check/scores-operator.json, identical to the subagent's on all 40. 15 replies have a blocker; 25 are clean.
benchmark.inputs: Each review receives the same rendering-bound text the scorers saw (scene fields and present ids), the moment and same-section neighbor excerpts, the section cast with hasForm, and the brief's depiction rules. No grounding audit, contract or outcome.

retryPolicy: One review per reply, with reviewPlan's own single retry for a malformed or invalid report. No other rerun. A provider error, missing usage, uncertain outcome or exhausted reserve stops the run.

targets.recall: At least 13 of the 15 defective replies are reported with at least one problem.
targets.falseAlarms: At most 3 of the 25 clean replies are reported with any problem.
targets.unavailable: At most 2 of 40 reviews end unavailable (two invalid reports).
targets.decision: Meeting all three: wire this checker into preparation as specified. Missing any: do not wire it; report per-kind results for the owner.

perKind: Reported for information: agreement of checker kinds with the scorer flags (unselected_figure=U, outside_instant=X, not_one_instant=I, embodied_formless=F). Kind mismatches do not affect the targets, which are reply-level, because a re-plan acts on any reported problem.

haiku-low.declaredAfter: haiku-none missed the false-alarm target (25/25 clean replies flagged).
haiku-low.change: Same model, prompt, schema, validation and benchmark; only reasoning effort 'low' and maxTokens 4000 (Anthropic requires a thinking budget of at least 1,024 tokens below max_tokens).
haiku-low.targets: Same three targets and decision rule as targets above.
haiku-low.ifMissed: Do not wire any checker. Report both arms; a stronger model or option (c) needs the owner's decision and budget.
